faqs.question: What is ADCET?
faqs.answer: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering and Technology (ADCET), Ashta is an autonomous engineering institute affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur and approved by AICTE, New Delhi.

faqs.question: Where is ADCET located?
faqs.answer: ADCET is located at Ashta, in Walwa Taluka of Sangli district, Maharashtra.

faqs.question: What courses are offered at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various engineering and technology disciplines, along with programs in areas such as Computer Applications and Business Administration.

faqs.question: How can I apply for admission?
faqs.answer: Students seeking admission should follow the admission procedure prescribed by the relevant admission authorities. Candidates should check the official admission information for eligibility, application procedure, important dates and required documents.

faqs.question: Is ADCET an autonomous institute?
faqs.answer: Yes. Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering and Technology, Ashta is an Empowered Autonomous Institute affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

faqs.question: Is ADCET approved by AICTE?
faqs.answer: Yes. The engineering programs offered by ADCET are approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi.

faqs.question: Is ADCET accredited by NAAC?
faqs.answer: Yes. ADCET has been accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) with an A++ grade.

faqs.question: Are hostel facilities available?
faqs.answer: Yes. ADCET provides hostel facilities for students along with campus amenities and other student support facilities.

faqs.question: Does ADCET provide placement assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes. The institute has a dedicated Training and Placement system that supports students through placement activities, industry interaction, training programs and recruitment opportunities.

faqs.question: How can I contact ADCET?
faqs.answer: Students and visitors can contact the institute through the official contact details provided on the ADCET website or visit the Contact Us section of this website.

faqs.question: Where can I find the latest college notices?
faqs.answer: Latest announcements, circulars, academic updates, examination information and other notices can be found in the Notices section of the website.

faqs.question: Where can I find information about faculty members?
faqs.answer: Faculty information is available department-wise. Students can visit the Faculty section to view information about faculty members and their respective departments.

faqs.question: When was ADCET established and what is its accreditation status?
faqs.answer: ADCET was established in 1999 and is an Empowered Autonomous Institute affiliated with Shivaji University, Kolhapur. It is approved by AICTE, accredited with a NAAC A++ Grade, and offers NBA-accredited programs.

faqs.question: What engineering programs are available at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses in fields including Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, and Electrical Engineering.

faqs.question: What are the placement statistics for ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET has placed over 2,281 students across more than 180 visiting recruiting companies. The highest salary package achieved is 40 LPA, with an average package of 4 LPA.

faqs.question: Where is ADCET located and how big is the campus?
faqs.answer: ADCET is located in Ashta, Sangli in Western Maharashtra. The institute features a campus spread over more than 25 acres.

faqs.question: What facilities are provided on the ADCET campus?
faqs.answer: The campus offers modern laboratories, hostel facilities, college bus service, a large playground, high-speed internet connectivity, modern classrooms with CCTV, and an on-campus ATM banking facility.

faqs.question: What is the contact address of ADCET?
faqs.answer: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering and Technology (ADCET) is located at Ashta, District Sangli, Maharashtra - 416 301.

faqs.question: What is the official phone number for ADCET?
faqs.answer: You can contact ADCET by phone at +91-8600600700.

faqs.question: What is the email address for contacting ADCET?
faqs.answer: For inquiries, admission information, or assistance, you can email ADCET at director@adcet.in.

faqs.question: What is the official website of ADCET?
faqs.answer: The official website of the institution is www.adcet.ac.in.

faqs.question: For which academic year are admissions open at ADCET?
faqs.answer: Admissions are currently open for the academic year 2026-27.

faqs.question: What programs are offered for admission at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers admission to various undergraduate (B.Tech) and postgraduate engineering programs.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility requirements for admission?
faqs.answer: Candidates must meet the prescribed academic and entrance examination requirements for their selected program.

faqs.question: What documents do students need to prepare for admission?
faqs.answer: Students should prepare their academic certificates, identity documents, photographs, and other required admission documents.

faqs.question: What steps should students take before applying to ADCET?
faqs.answer: Students seeking admission are advised to check the eligibility criteria, admission schedule, required documents, and application procedure before submitting their application.

faqs.question: Who is the Head of Department for Computer Science & Engineering at ADCET?
faqs.answer: Dr. Suhel S. Sayyad serves as the Professor and Head of Department for Computer Science & Engineering. He has 16.5 years of experience with expertise in Information Security and High Performance Computing.

faqs.question: Who heads the Artificial Intelligence & Data Science department at ADCET?
faqs.answer: Dr. Asma A. Shaikh is the Professor & Head of Department for Artificial Intelligence & Data Science. She holds a Post Doc (CSE) and Ph.D. (CSE) with 18 years of experience.

faqs.question: Who is the Head of Department for Robotics & Artificial Intelligence?
faqs.answer: Dr. Sunita Sunil Shinde is the Professor & Head of Department for Robotics & Artificial Intelligence. She has 25 years of experience with expertise in Wireless Communication and IoT.

faqs.question: Who leads the Basic Science department at ADCET?
faqs.answer: Dr. Santosh Shivaji Desai is the Associate Professor & Head of the Basic Science department. He has 16 years of experience and specializes in Mathematics and Fuzzy Choice Theory.

faqs.question: How many faculty members are listed under the Aeronautical Engineering department?
faqs.answer: There are 4 faculty members listed under the Aeronautical Engineering department at ADCET.

faqs.question: What B.Tech programs are offered at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers B.Tech programs in Mechanical, Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical, Civil, Aeronautical, Food Technology, AI and Data Science, CSE (IoT and Cyber Security), Robotics and AI, and Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering.

faqs.question: What other undergraduate programs besides B.Tech are offered at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers two other undergraduate programs: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) with an intake of 200 and Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) with an intake of 60.

faqs.question: What M.Tech programs are available at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers M.Tech programs in Mechanical Engineering Design, Computer Science And Engineering, Electrical Power System, and Civil Engineering (Computer Aided Structural Engineering). Each of these M.Tech programs has an intake of 12 students.

faqs.question: What is the student intake capacity for B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at ADCET?
faqs.answer: The B.Tech program in Computer Science & Engineering at ADCET has an intake capacity of 180 students.

faqs.question: How are admissions processed for programs at ADCET?
faqs.answer: Admission to programs at ADCET is subject to the eligibility criteria and procedures prescribed by the concerned authorities. Students are advised to check the official admission information for the latest details.

faqs.question: Which programs are open for admission at ADCET for the 2026–27 academic year?
faqs.answer: Admissions are open for B.Tech and M.Tech programs for the academic year 2026–27. Interested candidates can apply through the official admission portal.

faqs.question: What is the theme for ADCET Hackathon 2026 Season 3?
faqs.answer: The theme for ADCET Hackathon 2026 – Season 3 is Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) – Vikasit Bharat-2047. Registration is open for all eligible students.

faqs.question: How can students apply for AICTE Scholarship and Fellowship Schemes?
faqs.answer: Students are advised to apply for the AICTE Scholarship and Fellowship Schemes through the official portal.

faqs.question: Where can students check the Odd Semester 2026–27 exam schedule?
faqs.answer: The examination schedule for the odd semester 2026–27 has been published on the notice board for students to check.

faqs.question: How can ADCET alumni update their details in the college database?
faqs.answer: All alumni are requested to update their details using the official ADCET alumni database update form.

faqs.question: Who should students contact for clarifications regarding admissions or notices?
faqs.answer: For any clarification, students can contact the respective department or the admission cell.

faqs.question: When was ADCET established and where is it located?
faqs.answer: ADCET was established in 1999 and is located on a 25-acre campus in the city of Ashta, Sangli, Maharashtra.

faqs.question: What accreditations and approvals does ADCET hold?
faqs.answer: ADCET is an Empowered Autonomous institute approved by AICTE and affiliated with Shivaji University, Kolhapur. It is NAAC accredited with an "A++" Grade, ISO 9001:2015 certified, runs NBA-accredited programs, and is accredited by TCS, Mumbai.

faqs.question: What financial support is available for students at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers robust student scholarship support to help make education affordable. Additionally, the institute provides 100% support for obtaining educational loans through nationalized banks.

faqs.question: What are the core values of ADCET?
faqs.answer: The institute's core values are defined by the Four C's: Competence, Confidence, Commitment, and Compassion.

faqs.question: What key campus facilities are available at ADCET?
faqs.answer: ADCET offers modern state-of-the-art laboratories, CCTV-monitored classrooms, 500 Mbps leased line internet, an on-campus ATM, student hostels, college bus services, and a huge playground.

faqs.question: What is the vision of ADCET?
faqs.answer: The vision of ADCET is "To be a Leader in producing professionally competent engineers."
